label: 屈膝侧坐后撑
pose_lead: Grounded pose, side-sit with one knee bent up and rear support:
lower_limbs: One leg bends upright with the sole near the front of the body; the other folds away to the side.
upper_limbs: One hand rests on the raised knee, the other placed behind the body to prop on the ground.
torso_head: The upper body leans slightly back and tilts toward the supporting hand; the head turns just a little sideways.
weight_silhouette: Hips, one foot and the rear hand form a three-point support; the outline carries a strong diagonal.
